identity: generic AR/M4-family rifle; exact configuration unresolved

frames.name: hero_left.png
findings: upper and lower receivers remain broad rectangular slabs
magazine is a rectangular box without a continuous curved shell
front and rear sight pieces float disconnected above their bases
handguard side details read as repeated attached blocks rather than credible ventilation or mounting geometry
material response is nearly monochrome and does not separate polymer, steel, aluminum, and rubber

frames.name: hero_right.png
findings: receiver silhouette remains toy-like and mechanically unresolved
stock is an oversized faceted shell with minimal functional exterior articulation
grip and magazine remain visibly primitive
floating sight components are plainly visible

frames.name: side_profile_left.png
findings: silhouette does not convincingly resolve an AR/M4-family hero weapon
magazine has no credible curvature or feed-lip transition
rail and handguard repetition is visibly procedural
front sight appears as three disconnected vertical bars

frames.name: top_mechanical.png
findings: top rail spacing and construction read as repetitive blocks
receiver and handguard transitions lack mechanical resolution
frame is washed out and does not reveal high-poly surface detail
sight geometry is partially absent or disconnected from the visible assembly

frames.name: muzzle_front.png
findings: muzzle device is faceted and blocky
handguard reads as a primitive polygonal tube with attached tiles
front sight floats far above the handguard
receiver mass remains a beveled box

frames.name: stock_rear.png
findings: stock lacks credible adjustable-carbine construction, latch detail, and buttpad articulation
receiver rear remains a featureless slab
rear aperture assembly floats above its base
material and edge hierarchy remain insufficient for a first-person hero asset

frames.name: first_person_hip.png
findings: first-person view exposes coarse rail repetition and broad primitive surfaces
front sight is disconnected and visually implausible
weapon lacks close-range material and geometric detail

frames.name: first_person_ads.png
findings: rear aperture is an oversized faceted ring that fills most of the frame
front sight components appear as three floating vertical bars rather than a connected sight assembly
sight picture is not visually credible for first-person iron-sight use
ADS composition fails the hero-asset realism requirement

decision.reason: The live OAuth Blender MCP method functioned and produced the required technical package, but the resulting geometry and presentation remain primitive, disconnected, visibly procedural, and non-credible at first-person distance after both authorized correction passes.
